title: Énergie noire à source externe — corpus, juges et outils (falsification-as-code)
description: A one-parameter dark-energy law, w(z) = -beta/(3Ht), derived from the accretion of a parent black hole, audited against Pantheon+, DESI DR2 and Planck under pre-registered criteria (91 frozen, 207 registry entries, 76 claims refuted). An arbiter for DESI DR3 is sealed by hash BEFORE the data — sha256(scelle.py) = 68d06bcccbecf2276919c05dc841c6d878ca2516427e533af38d64344aed45a2 — with exhaustive verdicts and non-modifiable thresholds. Includes an atlas of 19 rival models under a single pipeline and five falsification-as-code tools (Registre, Adversaire, Audience, k-tracker, Scelle) that freeze a success criterion in a script's docstring and break the build if it moves after the fact. This version 1.0-pre is deposited before DESI DR3: its Zenodo timestamp proves the priority of the sealed prediction.
